MCA.wiki: The governing body appointed by Earth-based United Nations member states to oversee planetary infrastructure, labor quotas, trade licenses, and resource export back to Earth.

EVA.wiki: Work performed by colonists or engineers outside the protective pressurized environment of a habitat or pressurized rover, requiring advanced pressurized space suits and life-support backpacks.

ISRU.wiki: The practice of harvesting and manufacturing essential consumables (water ice, breathable oxygen, methane rocket fuel, and building regolith) directly from Martian local resources rather than transporting them from Earth.

Hab.wiki: Pressurized, radiation-shielded subsurface or dome structures providing living quarters, hydroponics bays, air scrubbers, and recreational spaces for Martian colonists.

Sol.wiki: The duration of one solar rotation on Mars, approximately 24 hours, 39 minutes, and 35 seconds, used as the fundamental unit of timekeeping for planetary operations.

ECLSS.definition: Environmental Control and Life Support System
ECLSS.wiki: The critical mechanical and bio-regenerative network that monitors atmospheric pressure, recycles water, scrubs carbon dioxide, and generates breathable oxygen across Martian facilities.

UN.wiki: The governing coalition of terrestrial nation-states holding supreme charter authority over sovereign space territories, colonial taxation, and space-faring legal jurisdictions.

UNSC.wiki: The executive committee empowered under interplanetary treaty to authorize military intervention, naval blockades, and peacekeeping task forces beyond low Earth orbit.

SSTO.wiki: Reusable shuttle craft capable of launching from the Martian surface into planetary orbit and landing without jettisoning booster stages or drop tanks.

RCS.wiki: A subsystem of thrusters used for three-axis attitude control, docking maneuvers, and fine orbital adjustments on transit spacecraft and orbital shuttles.
